response.sql: WITH order_net_rates AS (SELECT o.recordvault, u.userstamp, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM orders o INNER JOIN fees f ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users u ON u.userstamp = o.userlink WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.recordvault, u.userstamp, u.acctscope), scope_stats AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_net_rates GROUP BY acctscope), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS overall_avg FROM scope_stats) SELECT ss.acctscope, ss.avg_net_rate, ss.order_count, ss.avg_net_rate - oa.overall_avg AS deviation FROM scope_stats ss CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ss.acctscope
